text:
[Council File 25-1538]
Statutory Exemption from the provisions of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Article 18, Section 15262 of the California CEQA Guidelines, and Article II, Section 2(d) of the City CEQA Guidelines; Board of Recreation and Park Commissioners report relative to the 2025 Citywide Park Needs Assessment (PNA), a Public Recreation Plan update to include the new park classifications established in the PNA, and an amendment to Los Angeles Municipal Code Section 12.33.E.3 to update the spending radii.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Yes
Community Impact Statement:
Yes
For: Downtown Los Angeles Neighborhood Council
summary: Report on the 2025 Citywide Park Needs Assessment and updates to the Public Recreation Plan and Municipal Code regarding park classifications and funding radii.

flag.reason: Updates how the City classifies parks and sets funding radii, a citywide parks policy.

outcome.text: Arts, Parks, and City Facilities Committee noted and filed item(s) (Oct 7, 2026)
